item.description:
• Live Grab: connect to a running Smaart and pull a live RTA or transfer function trace straight into the editor as an editable target curve
  • Import Smaart ASCII trace exports: open the file, drop it on the graph, or copy in Smaart and paste with Cmd+V
  • Flatten Selected (Cmd+F): select a rough section and press to ease it toward a straight line
  • Hold Cmd+Up or Cmd+Down to keep offsetting the curve
  • The editor warns you if the file behind your loaded curve is deleted
  • Smaart loads target curves when it starts. To see a newly saved curve in a running Smaart, use Import in its Target Curves window, or restart Smaart

• Open a .crv from Finder: double-click a curve, or drop one on the app icon, to load it
  • In the library's All view, a curve can now be dragged to the last spot in its group (previously it snapped back)
  • Point Spacing "Restore" is now reliable after you load or switch a curve, and it resets the offset correctly
  • Holding Option+arrow against a limit no longer wipes your undo history
  • Pressing T or S while drawing with the pencil no longer mixes up the curve
  • The D pencil shortcut no longer gets swallowed after typing in a text field
  • Right-click library actions no longer act on the wrong curve if the list refreshes while the menu is open
  • Library order is kept safe if the folder index cannot be written
  • After closing Split View, Shift+arrow zoom no longer targets the hidden preview

• Overlays now match Smaart: each overlay sits at its own saved offset and shows its own saved tolerance band (TF only)
  • Overlay Offset: shift all overlays together to compare curve shapes (view only, never saved)
  • Match type now also focuses the library list to the curve you are editing; turn it off to browse and filter freely
  • OVERLAYS panel tidied: Show toggle on the title row, Tolerance is now a show/hide toggle

• Wider point range: 16 Hz to 22 kHz (was 20 Hz–20 kHz)
  • Smooth drag-reorder for the curve list, plus right-click Move to Top/Up/Down/Bottom
  • New view-only ± dB tolerance band on overlays, and overlay controls grouped into one panel
  • Grid view now resets on launch
  • Redo (Cmd+Shift+Z)
  • Help menu: built-in Guide & Keyboard Shortcuts
  • Undo now covers everything, not just points
  • Better file handling: banding round-trips, legacy files load, missing folder offers a re-pick

item.title: Version 1.0.1
item.description: Fixes incorrect A and C frequency weighting at 0 Hz.
